summary: Replace platform-specific tasks with cli_command blocks per platform, or with group_vars per platform defining the command, reduce it to a single cli_command task.
questions: How do I run the same show command on Arista, Cisco and VyOS?
How can group_vars make one cli_command task work for all platforms?

answer_card.title: Use cli_command across platforms
answer_card.answer_md:
Simplest form, with each platform's `group_vars` defining `show_interfaces`:
```yaml
- name: Run command and print to terminal window
  hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Run show command
      ansible.netcommon.cli_command:
        command: "{{ show_interfaces }}"
      register: command_output
```
Without group_vars you'd use one `cli_command` block per platform with `when: ansible_network_os == ...`. Requires `connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli`.
